note.p: This corpus compiles over 800 examples of adjective-adverbs in four regional varieties of Southern Italy. The dialectal data from Sicilia (130 examples), Calabria (52 examples) and Salento (200 examples) stems from contemporaneous texts. The much larger corpus of Neapolitan (462 examples) ranges from the 14th century to the present day. The corpus is based on individual readings of texts; the bibliography is listed under sources. The reading and compilation of examples was carried out by Adam Ledgeway (2000-2017), who analysed the examples in several publications regarding features such as adverbial agreement. The data is not restricted to verb-modification (e.g. in Calabrese: scriva biello chiaru ‘s/he writes beautifully, clearly’), but the adjective-adverbs show different adverbial functions (e.g. focus adverbs such as Neapolitan simmo iusto quatto 'we are exactly four'). In order to integrate the examples into the aaif-database (FWF-Project “Open Access Database - Adjective-Adverb Interfaces in Romance”, ORD 66-VO), the data have been annotated by Katharina Gerhalter in 2019. In order to unify variation in different dialects and to easily enable lemma searching, the verbs and adverbs in the examples were lemmatized with the corresponding standard Italian lemma (e.g. the example scriva biello chiaru from Calabria was lemmatized as: scrivere, bello, chiaro). In cases where there was no standard Italian equivalent, a reconstructed vernacular Latin lemma was proposed, preceded by an asterisk (for example, *COMMOGLIARE for the Neapolitan verb forms accumigliateva and commoglio 'I cover'). In total, 100 different adjectival lemmata are registered (see the List of Lemmata which includes the number of examples per lemma). The corpus is composed mainly by adjective-adverbs, but also contains a few adverbial locutions (prepositional phrases of the type “preposition + adjective” such as de veru ‘really’) as well as some idiomatic reduplications of nouns, which are used adverbially (e.g. miccia miccia ‘[to burn] weak’).

projectDesc.p: The research group on The Interfaces of Adjective and Adverb in Romance integrates several projects dealing with the complex relations between the word-classes of adjective and adverb in the history and the present of Romance languages, including contrastive studies with Germanic. The Research group was formally founded at the University of Graz in 2006. Approximately 40 books and articles have been published, two conferences were held in Graz, and two FWF projects (P 15806, P 25467) have been granted (see Homepage https://adjective-adverb.uni-graz.at). The current project (P 25467) ends in September 2016. It aims at publishing the Historical Dictionary of French Adjective-Adverbs which will come out as a flagship publication that considerably increases the impact of research in both, the scientific community as well as the general public. A first version has been finished right now, so that we are looking forward to conclude the project successfully and in time. The project we apply for is a cooperation of two partners joining the linguistic competence (Department of Romance Studies) with the required IT-competence (Centre for Information Modelling - Austrian Centre for Digital Humanities, hereafter ZIM-ACDH)1.

The proposed project intends to technically update and integrate the corpora collected by the Research group and its international partners into a general database. In addition, the future database will be used as a platform for corpora prepared at other universities, at least Cambridge and Cluj-Napoca (Rumania). In order to ensure a maximum of continuity and compatibility, the database will follow several linguistically relevant standards established and promoted by the European Research Infrastructure Consortium for language resources CLARIN ERIC2. All data shall be newly tagged according to the criteria that have been used for two Spanish corpora (CDH Verb + Adjective - Adverb Examples and Spanish Basis_SH3 Corpus, henceforth CDH and SH3). The new database will allow for cross-linguistic generalizations, especially if, as we hope, more data from more languages can be integrated in a long-term perspective. In view of this, the following aspects are crucial for the project: open access, adaptation of international standards, development of standards for tagging in the domain of adjective and adverb according to major research issues, linking the data to other language resources via linked open data, improvement of retrieval and analysis with regard to response time and search options.

abstract.p: Corpus of adjective-adverbs in southern varieties of Italy: dialect literature from Naples (14th to 21st century), Sicilia, Calabria and Salento (20th and 21st century).

p.s: Allura non canusci bonu a tò patri, basta ca ti mariti bedda pulita , iddu ti fa maritari cu unu senza ‘na gamba, senza occhi, senza manu, checcu e beccu

s.phr: Allura ti po curari bona
prima a vulissi canusciri bona chi razza di piru è
siddu havissi vulutu, m’avissi truccatu bonu e un ci avissiru statu problemi
Si sulu unu ca siddu ‘un fa bona la so parti, caru miu, sicuramenti haj di chi liccariti bonu l’ugna, gran pezzu di sdisanuratu!
siddu mi fa siddiari bona bona u jiettu da finestra!
ma ti senti bona a mugghieri?
cci la dissi bona
Mettatillu bonu ‘nta sta cucuzza: non l’avemu!
Comunque, sentimi bonu
Ti facissi ballari io, e bona

p.s: Tuttu chistu nun si chiama munnizza?

s.phr: E si facemu bonu li cunta di quantu pagu di tassa di munnizza
E allura fici bonu ca u ttaccai ‘nta ‘n peri di patata?
non capii bonu
Lassa ca ci pensu bonu e poi ni parramu
Maria ma tu chi dici ca ficimu bonu a dirici si o nannu ppi s’elezioni?
Giustu diciunu i carusi
Maria giustu sta dicennu
Dicu giustu , Pitrusì?
dumani è festa e si mancia bonu !
Vadda ca ancora bonu ci sentu
E non fanu bonu ?
Sugnu sempri cchiù cunvintu, ca ficimu a cosa giusta cu’ ‘sta vacanza
e parrassi chiaru
Capì bonu ?
E chi parra beddu !
Parramini chiaru : chi c’è sutta?
e pirchì non parri chiaru ?!
Di cucinari, iddu cucina bonu
Vui durmiu così beddu !
Eppuru, pinsannucci bonu , aviti ragiuni.
Don Pippinu mi pari ca vossia ddocu non ci visti bonu
non sugnu cecu, cu stu occhiu ci vidu bonu
Vossa riposa tranquillu ca a chiddu ci pensu io
non si sapi bonu di unni veni
E la liggi di chistu feudu parra chiaru

p.s: Quali lenti?!

s.phr: Iù bona ci vidu !

p.s: Iddi sunu.

s.phr: Avanti, con noialtri putiti parrari tranquilli
diversamenti non ci n’è unu ca ci va bonu
havi tri ghiorna ca mi priparu, ma bona nisciu , averu?
e già ca semu cumminati bboni chi sordi…
Senti o pa’ non fari tutti sti tragedii picchì mi pari ca tuttu sommato a famigghia camina bona
tuttu bonu finisci
oggi dumani s’avissa a diri ca l’elezioni non foru fatti boni
E buoni iamu !
si sta boni ccà
Ppì stavolta ti ìu bona
Bona accuminciau a jurnata!
Mi jetta difficili veniri, eccu!
Non veni bonu lu bollitu!
Si eramu cumminati boni , ‘a’st’ura chi eramu ccà?

p.s: tutto apposto con le radioline?

s.phr: Funzionanu boni , abberu?
anchi si di vestiri visteva bonu
Va beni, basta ca su sarvati bboni
nonn’è ca mi sona tantu ritta sta cosa
alla mia età a prostata non funziona bona
Quannu i cosi ‘nveci pi vossia vannu boni
quannu li cosi nun vannu boni
Su non cci fussunu i luci issumu a finiri ritti ritti ‘nta cucina intra a pigghiata cco ministruni

p.s: Io’ non sugnu scimunitu capemu?

s.phr: A mia a testa mi ragiuna bona
Prisidenti sbagghiai, ancora m’haia ‘mparari bona
Si spiegassi bonu
ti pigghi st’anticchia d’acqua e ninni iemu o travagghiu ca si fici tardu ?
Non ti senti bonu ?
Pripariti bonu ppi st’elezioni
Ma taliatilu comu si ‘nsignau bonu a parrari u signurinu
Cu è ca non si senti bonu ?
Iù bona mi sentu
Ti cunsigghiu di diri l’autra menza, prima ca mi siddìu bona bona!
Cunfessati bona , ‘u senti?
Ma state attenti pirchì si m’ incazzu bonu bonu…!
Un lu vidi ca mancu si sapi esprimiri bona
E poi su non vi truvati boni , putiti sempri turnari
l’unica cosa chi ti putissi ‘nvidiari a tia putissi essiri a gioventù, ma io’ a me ma fici eppuru bona grazie a Diu!
Videva ddà rota ca furriava e ddà pallina ca si firmava giustu giustu ‘ntè nummira ca jù hava pinsatu prima
Boni si cumminaru tutti dui!
Sempri malamenti mi tratta ma cugnatu, chi ci successi??
